commits: dfb5180f feat(du4): implement bounded operating-relation detection (DU4-STATE)

limits: partial saved observation, not full original or complete native corpus
tests only read this retained JSON; the original PDF is never reopened
32 synthetic originals + 16 extended counterexamples + 4 holdouts are embedded specs in tests/unit/du4_operating_states/test_b_synthetic_specs.py (kind synthetic), not market recall samples

known_limits: assertion_refs is the clause evidence span (its tail may exceed the bound, e.g. 的情况); the binding itself lives in actor/object/predicate/qualifier refs

attribution classes: issuer pronouns -> issuer; related-party nouns (股东/控股股东/母公司/子公司/关联方/parent/subsidiary) -> quoted_related_party; third-party nouns -> other; bare names -> unknown; subsidiary and shareholder are the same related-party class and stay distinguishable only via actor_refs
actor name classes come only from bounded cues inside the target unit and same-parent context units; no entity DB, no external identity check
binary yes/no Q+A answers without an observed referent ('没有。' / 'No.') yield no relation; referent closure across units is not guessed — any source-consumer change stays ROOT-owned
restriction-continuation ('仅用于试用') attaches only to the immediately preceding relation of the same unit
no quantity/period/currency parsing; numbers stay in source wording
double negation and undeterminable scope emit modality=uncertain with polarity=unknown; they are never inverted into positives

low-information guards (definition / administrative receipt / generic wish / vision / financial composition) act at clause granularity; a no-punctuation run-on mixing a definition and a real denial is guarded as a whole, so assertion-level guard scoping inside unpunctuated clauses is a future refinement
abstract risk/issue objects (风险/问题/挑战/uncertainty ...) never become operating objects, so negation-existence boilerplate ('公司不存在经营风险。') yields no relation instead of a polarity flip
not_run: owner original reopen / real parse replay
real selection (selector) integration and complete-QA/cap regression

real model summary generation AND its independent subject/stage claim review (the four-row meaning table: a parent->issuer change or hope->contract change is a quality failure even when JSON/citations validate)
READING_BUSINESS_POLICY_VERSION bump and cache invalidation (ROOT owns narrative_business_policy.py)
root_integration_steps: In source_catalog/narrative_business_policy.py::detect_reading_business_fact, consume detect_operating_relations via a thin adapter that wraps the text as one observation unit (schema du4-operating-observation/1; unit fields text/parent_id/role/kind/locator may be caller placeholders; no source re-signature). The adapter must pass a caller-owned shared WorkBudget; the component never creates budgets.

Relation -> OperatingFact mapping (suggested): reasons add 'operating_state_boundary' when polarity=negative or stage in (not_yet, suspended, discontinued) or modality=uncertain; add 'business_relationship_stage' when activity=business_relationship and stage in (contact_established, intended_cooperation, planned, conditional). topics: core_business base; capacity_projects when activity in (production, capacity) and polarity=positive and stage=current; new_business when stage in (planned, conditional, intended_cooperation). Never emit business_progress for denials or non-progress states; ordinary bounded score (3), never scaled by negation-token count.

Remove the reading-only bare OBJECT x ACTIVITY co-occurrence branch (narrative_business_policy.py near line 534: activity = any(_OBJECT.search(clause) and _ACTIVITY.search(clause) ...)) so the new relation semantics cannot be bypassed; keep legacy detect_business_fact, N6 recognition and explicit 0.8 replay untouched.
Bump READING_BUSINESS_POLICY_VERSION (reading-business-policy/6 -> 7) with the existing inventory import; add the single cache invalidation assertion through the real inventory/freezer/comparator.

Keep role admission at the source/structure boundary: the component is role-agnostic and its interrogative guard is text-level only; question/shadow roles must keep failing _admitted as they do today.
Pass context_unit_ids = the same-parent observed context (e.g. m41 siblings); never trim QA package members — the component only reads units and returns relations.

After the live summary node, run the independent subject/stage claim review over the four-row meaning table: a parent->issuer change or a hope->contract/order/shipment change is a quality failure even when JSON and citations validate. This review is ROOT-owned and is NOT covered by this lane's tests.
